step_metadata.name: Stakeholder Validation
step_metadata.description: Obtain stakeholder validation of functional architecture via visual review (CONDITIONAL based on user preference)

conditional_execution.if_true: Execute full stakeholder validation process (all actions below)
conditional_execution.if_false: SKIP this step entirely - proceed directly to FA-05 (technical analysis)
conditional_execution.check_at_step_start: LLM agent MUST read working_memory.json and check user_preferences.stakeholder_approval_required before executing this step

rationale: Stakeholder sign-off on functional architecture BEFORE service allocation prevents costly rework, scope creep, and misalignment between stakeholder expectations and implemented system. Visual diagrams enable non-technical stakeholders to validate design. However, for personal/hobby projects, this formal process may be unnecessary overhead.
mandatory: CONDITIONAL - If user_preferences.stakeholder_approval_required == true, this gate is BLOCKING. If false, this step is SKIPPED entirely.

participants.domain_experts: Validate domain logic and functional flows are correct
participants.technical_leads: Validate technical feasibility and integration points
participants.end_users: Validate usability and user interaction flows (if available)

review_questions: Do the functional flows accurately represent how the system should work?
Are there missing functions needed to support user scenarios?
Are there unnecessary functions that don't add business value?
Do the decision points cover all necessary conditions and edge cases?
Are error handling flows appropriate and complete?
Does the functional architecture align with your expectations?
Is the scope appropriate (not too large, not too small)?
Are there integration points with external systems that are missing?

feedback_categories: Missing functions: Functions needed but not present
Unnecessary functions: Functions that don't add value
Incorrect flows: Flow sequences that don't match actual business processes
Missing decision branches: Decision points missing necessary conditions
Misalignment: Functional architecture doesn't match stakeholder expectations
Scope concerns: Scope too large (overengineering) or too small (incomplete)

severity_classification.CRITICAL: Missing functions, incorrect flows, major misalignment - MUST address before proceeding
severity_classification.WARNING: Scope concerns, minor inefficiencies - SHOULD address

approved.criteria: No CRITICAL stakeholder issues, stakeholders sign off on functional architecture

refinements_needed.next_action: Return to FA-02 (refine functional flows/functions) or FA-03 (regenerate visualizations)

typical_time: 1-2 hours for review session, plus refinement time if issues found
next_step: FA-05 (technical analysis) OR return to FA-02/FA-03 if refinements needed
